title: Built for authors, by authors
use_cases: Use when evaluating the security of creative intellectual property
Use when assessing if platform content is utilized for LLM training
Implement when commercializing stories or visualizations created within the tool
Configure when managing data lifecycle and permanent deletion of drafts
content:
Your drafts and creations belong to you—always. Mythril is a tool to fuel your creativity by letting you focus on what you love: writing stories

#### You own everything you create

All visualizations, compendium data, and content generated in Mythril remain your intellectual property, with full commercial rights.

#### Your drafts stay private

We never train AI models on your work, share your content with third parties, or use your stories for any purpose beyond providing you service.

#### Delete anytime, truly gone

When you delete your work from Mythril, it's permanently removed from our systems. No hidden copies, no backups being data mined.
